title: Fix four bugs in a statistics module
description: A statistics module has four bugs: mean divides by wrong value, median doesn't sort, variance uses wrong formula, stdev calls wrong function.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix four bugs in src/stats.py:
1. `mean`: remove the `+ 1` — just `return sum(data) / len(data)`
2. `median`: sort a copy first — `sorted_data = sorted(data)`, then index into sorted_data
3. `variance`: remove the `+ 1` from the denominator — `/ len(data)`
4. `stdev`: change `** 2` to `** 0.5`
All 5 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
